paragraphs.text:
Legend says that the wind-walker has strange feet. You let the 
suspect sleep. When you think he is deep in slumber, you creep 
toward him. To get the proof you need, you must merely open 
the bandages and examine his feet, without waking him.

Make a Sleight of Hand roll: if you succeed, go to 204; if you fail, 
go to 80.
